notes.title: Bug fixes for 8.23.21
notes.notes:
Some small Block Knockers updates and code cleaning. In particular, a bug was reported that the Game Clear achievement for defeating the final boss no longer worked if you skipped the end boss initially. It works again, and if you fell victim to this bug, the game can tell and the achievement will trigger at the stage menu without you needing to fight the boss again.

This time, some of the older programming functions I was using in the game finally got completely removed from GMS, or changed to the point that they no longer worked in the context I was using them, so I replaced them with new ones. However, that meant I had to do much more thorough testing than I anticipated for this small update, to make sure I got them all.

Everything looks like it's back in order, but please contact me or post on the forum if you run into anything! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Holiday Update -- 12/19/2019
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35399205/c1e5ba976b1fe21738b511f4ffc3cabe4ce33d8e.png

A new update has just dropped, in the spirit of a certain major winter holiday that maybe you've heard of! A new stage has been added, and this can be accessed via a Secret Menu that unlocks when you've cleared the game.. But, having added a whole new menu section, it would be lame if there were only one stage in it, so I'll be adding new content in there over the coming months. Hope you enjoy! 

And as always, on my end, user reviews are extremely appreciated! They help boost the game in Steam's recommendation algorithm, and when we get enough I'll be able to add Steam Trading Cards and all the extra goodies that goes with them. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update and bug fixes for Aug 3 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35399205/c1e5ba976b1fe21738b511f4ffc3cabe4ce33d8e.png
Hey everyone! Big thanks to everyone who has supported Crawlco Block Knockers so far. (And advance thanks to everyone who comes later!) Thanks to a few sharp-eyed players I have a few bugs fixed and changes made already:

- Ending/Game clear achievement wasn't triggering if players died 3 or more times against the end boss, should be fixed now
- Ending changed slightly when in "hide" mode, fixed some credit spacing issues
- Added "quick tip" popup if player doesn't appear to have figured out the controls (helpful if you went in blind and skipped the tutorial)
- minor art adjustments
- Steam screen caps were not working correctly, should be fixed.

Thanks for playing! And if you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Reviews count for a lot in the way Steam keeps games visible over time, so it can help out a lot (and potentially get the game to the point where I can add things like chat icons and trading cards).
